scientific_integrity: Exact integer finite-difference proof with analytically established asymptotic and norm-closure claims; standalone finite checks are corroboration, not infinite-dimensional certification.
scientific_limitations: One-variable Gaussian Fock Hilbert space; fixed positive integer monomial power, variable derivative/integration order. Norm-closed linear span only; not arbitrary compact operators. Possible older equivalent polynomial symbolic-calculus identity remains a priority risk.
title: Rank-one finite-difference generators and sharp Schatten filtration for critical Fock integral jets
